objects.description:
[NIMBUS MANTICORE](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1059) has utilized Search Engine Optimization (SEO) poisoning to deliver malware to unsuspecting victims.(Citation: CheckPoint_NimbusManticore_May2026)  

[NIMBUS MANTICORE](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1059) has also registered dozens of domains that link to a typosquatted domain to generate link-based reputation signals and incorporated keyword stuffing to improve search ranking.(Citation: CheckPoint_NimbusManticore_May2026)
